effects.lua_implementation: Attack-announcement field trigger from hand/GY requires two zones, summons this card plus another Level 1 simultaneously, and negates the attack only if both summon; id HOPT.

effects.printed_clause: Level 1 monsters cannot be destroyed by battle.
